verdict.rationale: n8n advertises 1500+ integrations, and its docs list many built-in nodes and credentials (Slack, HubSpot, Jira, Notion, GitHub, Datadog, Okta, and others) included on every plan. Community users confirm they rely on these pre-made blocks instead of building and maintaining API integrations themselves. Missing for 10: the documented count is 1500+, short of 'thousands'; vendor maintenance is only implied by the 'builtin' docs path, not stated; some built-in node docs are thin (e.g. the Kafka trigger page has no info).
